title: Page 67
transc:
Ft Monroe April 19th 1864
Maj Eckert Di 
for Brutus growl unity I have sent the following
to to Jupiter Yoke Knave Zebra Another from Animal
April hope Fanny for Judah belly zodiac I have
received Communication that the Rome have oiled Plymouth in
Considerable Salem unity thus far have been Warsaw zebra 
their iron clads have not yet come into action
unity I have directed shelter Peck to make such
disposition Torch Saints in his District as best to
repel this Talbot zebra I have taken from him
a single pacific whip and a light pagoda unity
He must have feeble promise spit under his Pontiac
zodiac shall I do any thing more Walrus Knox
Geo D Sheldon


Ft Monroe April 19th 1864
Maj Eckert Di
for Bruno unity several purple wafer intended for Whartons in
my polka are now at pearls for wafer Stephen states
of Amos Austria Arabia Asia & Anthon zebra there are
more in Amos than the other states zodiac will you
please devise some means by which they can be sent
to their ships at once pedlar it is all important
to me that I should have them unity I am
satisfied that there is great negligence & want of energy
on the part of officers in charge torch Paxtons zodiac
The wafers for Maxims Pontiac should be hurried here as
fast as possible Webster Knave Francis very busy day here
Geo D Sheldon
